args.prompt:
One continuous 30-second take: a single unbroken camera move, no cuts, no jump cuts, no scene changes. Smooth gimbal, no shake. Cinematic 35mm film look, soft grain, warm golden-hour light.
CAST: @Image1 is the opening composition and set: a Paris café terrace at golden hour, a small round marble table with two espressos. @Image2 is the MAN (Otto): long pale face, heavy dark brows, swept-back hair with silver temples, an enormous charcoal-black handlebar moustache with spiral tips that completely covers his mouth, black turtleneck, charcoal blazer, oxblood pocket square, brass viewfinder on a chain. He always sits on the LEFT. His mouth is never visible; when he speaks, only his moustache and cheeks move. @Image3 is the WOMAN (Vee): platinum buzz cut, round vermilion-tinted spectacles, olive skin with freckles, oversized ivory double-breasted suit, vermilion scarf, one silver stopwatch on a chain. She always sits on the RIGHT. They keep their exact faces, wardrobe and seats for the whole shot.
@Audio1 is the exact dialogue track: the woman's confident British voice and the man's deep dry British voice. Lip-sync the woman's lines to her mouth; the man's lines move only his moustache.
FIRST FRAME: exactly @Image1.
RULES: real physics; one camera path; no new people in focus; gentle café life blurred in the background.
[0-3 s] The camera is already moving: a slow push toward the table. The woman turns to the lens and asks: "How much did your last product shoot cost?"
[3-6 s] The man lowers his viewfinder and says, deadpan: "Don't answer. It'll ruin your coffee." He sips his espresso.
[6-13 s] Without cutting, the camera drifts slightly right toward her as she says to camera, crisp: "We make thirty-second product films with AI. One take. No crew. No studio."
[13-18 s] The camera drifts back left toward him; he raises one brow and frames the lens with his viewfinder: "Just your product, and a little madness."
[18-23 s] The camera settles centred on both; she holds up her stopwatch: "Send us one photo. We send back five frames, free."
[23-26 s] He nods once: "Then we roll."
[26-30 s] She clicks the stopwatch, looks into the lens: "Link in bio." The camera holds on both of them, sunlight glinting on the espresso cups.
AUDIO: their dialogue only, soft café ambience; no music.
No text overlays, no subtitles, no logos, not a cartoon.
